text:
jamie: heads-up — starting infra change window for release/2026 in ~15m. planned: terraform apply for vpc networking (modules/net-*), then iam cross-account roles. need network + iam owners to ack. no db/schema changes.

alex: acked. i'll own networking apply. i can do the first pass and watch subnets + route tables.

maria: acked for IAM. i want to run the iam plan and validate role trusts before apply.

sam: quick q — are we still pinning the aws provider version for this rollout? last time we had drift b/c of provider bump.

jamie: yes — provider pinned to 4.2.1 in the env workspaces. snippet in repo: `provider "aws" { version = "~> 4.2.1" }`

deploy-bot: preflight started for thread=1795012345. running: `terraform plan -var-file=release-2026.tfvars --modules=net,iam`

deploy-bot: preflight results: network plan OK. iam plan: 1 risky change detected — update to assume_role policy for org-cross-account-role overlaps with active external sessions. (rule: iam-trust-overlap).

maria: hmm. that trust change is risky during traffic hours. can we split? network first, then hold iam until night window?

alex: +1 to split. network apply is low-risk and unblocks the release routing changes.

jamie: agreed. plan: apply network now (alex), cutover traffic, and defer iam role trust change to maintenance window at 02:00 UTC. will create a follow-up ticket and pin the iam plan until then.

ops-oncall: noted. i'll set the change window and alert rules. create rollback playbook for iam in case of regression.

maria: i will open a smaller follow-up PR that separates role trust vs policy attachments and include the manual verification steps for external sessions.

sam: also add a short blurb in release notes: "iam cross-account trust delayed to 02:00 UTC for safety; networking changes applied during day window."

deploy-bot: network apply queued by alex. command:```
terraform apply -target=module.vpc -auto-approve
```

alex: starting apply now. tailing logs: `apply: 3/3 resources added, 0 changed, 0 destroyed`

alex: network apply complete. routes propagated, peering attachments show 'available'.

jamie: great. rolling the release forward without iam trust changes. maria — please follow up with the iam plan pin + rollback doc. tagging ops-oncall for the night window. :thumbsup:

maria: will do. adding verification steps and a small rollback snippet:```
# rollback trust change
terraform apply -target=aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.org-assume -var-file=rollback.tfvars
```

ops-oncall: thanks — I've scheduled the 02:00 UTC maintenance window and added a PagerDuty override for the runbook. closing this thread for the day; reopening in night window for iam. :lock:
